HeroProfile.title: HeroProfile
HeroProfile.description: Durable RPG character stats, step energy, Sol Coins, progression (Realms, Spire, Skill Tree, Quests, Prestige), companion reference, and timed expedition state for an authenticated Solstride player.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this hero profile.

displayName.description: Hero display name shown in hub and leaderboard.

xp.description: Experience points within the current level.

xpToNextLevel.description: Experience required to reach the next level.

vigor.description: Vigor attribute increasing max HP and defense.

endurance.description: Endurance attribute increasing max Stride Energy.

unspentPoints.description: Unallocated Mastery Points earned on level-up.

strideEnergy.description: Solar Stride Energy charged by real-world steps.

sunshards.description: Upgrade currency earned from battles and salvage.

solCoins.description: Boss-exclusive currency (+10 per won boss battle) used for Camp Heal, Pets, and Pet Shop.

totalSteps.description: Lifetime tracked steps across smart watches and fitness trackers.

trueBossWins.description: Total Boss battles won (Highland, Realm Guardian, and Spire Warden bosses).

heroPower.description: Composite tactical power score derived from level, stats, equipped gear, skills, prestige, and pet.

equippedPetId.description: PetType ID of the single currently equipped companion, or empty string if none.

activeExpeditionStartMs.description: Epoch ms when the current timed expedition started (0 when idle).

activeExpeditionDurationMin.description: Duration in minutes (5..1380) of the active timed expedition (0 when idle).

activeExpeditionEndMs.description: Epoch ms when the active timed expedition completes (0 when idle).

realmStage.description: Current stage within the active Realm Chapter (1..5; stage 5 is the Realm Guardian Boss).

currentSpireFloor.description: Current floor reached in the Endless Spire Gauntlet (1..9999).

highestSpireFloor.description: All-time highest Endless Spire floor cleared (0..9999).

skillRanks.description: Compact 9-node Class Skill Tree rank vector (e.g. 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0).

dailyQuestDateKey.description: Calendar day key (YYYY-MM-DD) for daily quest counter resets.

dailyBattlesWon.description: Battles won today for daily quests.

dailyExpeditionsDone.description: Expeditions resolved today for daily quests.

dailyChestsOpened.description: Loot chests opened today for daily quests.

claimedQuestIds.description: Bounded list of claimed daily/weekly/milestone quest IDs (max 40).

chestsOpenedTotal.description: Lifetime count of loot chests cracked open.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on each update.

InventoryItem.title: InventoryItem
InventoryItem.description: Equippable weapon, armor, relic (with combat/expedition perks), or combat consumable owned by a player.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this item.

rarity.description: Rarity tier including expedition Ultra Rare drops.

energyBonus.description: Max Stride Energy bonus when equipped.

equipped.description: Whether the gear piece is currently equipped.

description.description: Concise item flavor or tactical effect summary.

perkType.description: Special passive combat or expedition survival perk on weapons, armor, and relics.

perkValue.description: Numeric percentage or magnitude of the gear perk (0..100).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

LootChest.title: LootChest
LootChest.description: Sealed treasure chest earned from battles, expeditions, Spire milestones, or quests that must be interactively tapped to open for gear and Ultra Rare relics.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this chest.

chestTier.description: Chest quality tier determining visual styling and loot table.

sourceLabel.description: Human-readable origin label such as Zenith Odyssey (23h) or Realm 2 Guardian.

heroLevelSnapshot.description: Hero level when the chest was earned.

durationMinutes.description: Expedition duration in minutes (0 for non-expedition chests, 5..1380 for expedition chests).

ultraRareChancePct.description: Exact percentage chance (0..100) to roll an Ultra Rare relic when opened.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when chest was earned.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when chest was earned.

OwnedPet.title: OwnedPet
OwnedPet.description: Companion pet unlocked and purchased with Sol Coins, tracking its level, XP, and equipped pet weapon/armor.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this pet.

level.description: Pet level increased by feeding Pet Food (1..50).

xp.description: Current pet XP within the current pet level.

xpToNextLevel.description: Pet XP needed to reach the next pet level.

equippedWeaponId.description: Shop weapon ID equipped on this pet, or empty string.

equippedArmorId.description: Shop armor ID equipped on this pet, or empty string.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on adoption.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public competitive leaderboard standing containing non-PII hero stats, Prestige rank, Spire record, and weekly step totals.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching document ID.

weekKey.description: ISO week key for weekly step rankings.

publicVisible.description: Explicit leaderboard visibility flag enforced by queries and rules.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

/users/{userId}.description: Private hero profile, Sol Coins, active pet reference, RPG progression (Realms, Spire, Skills, Quests, Prestige), and timed expedition state owned strictly by userId.

/users/{userId}/inventory/{itemId}.description: Private equipment and consumable items with combat/expedition perks belonging to userId.

/users/{userId}/chests/{chestId}.description: Private sealed treasure chests waiting to be interactively looted by userId.

/users/{userId}/pets/{petId}.description: Private owned companion pets with leveling and pet gear loadouts owned strictly by userId.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Public competitive leaderboard entries readable by signed-in players via publicVisible query and writable strictly by the owner.
